snippet.description:
Are Previous Year Questions (PYQs) still relevant for UPSC Prelims 2027, especially when the nature and difficulty of questions are constantly evolving?

The answer lies in understanding how to analyse PYQs, not just solve them.

Join Sonia Gupta, Head of Mentorship Program, LevelUp IAS, for a live workshop on The Right Approach to Solve PYQs for Prelims 2027.

Enroll for webinar: https://shorturl.at/jUvud

In this workshop, we will explore:
- How to identify important and recurring themes through PYQ analysis.
- How to use PYQs to revise and prioritise the UPSC syllabus.
- How to understand UPSC's question framing and eliminate confusing options.
- How to derive value from PYQs and strengthen conceptual clarity for Prelims 2027.

Workshop Details:
📅 Date: 2 December 2026 (Wednesday)  
⏰ Time: 5:00 PM  
📍 Mode: Online & Offline  
🎟️ Registration: Free

Special Benefit: All workshop participants will receive free PMP 2026 Economy Prelims Notes.

Register now and learn how to use PYQs more strategically for UPSC CSE Prelims 2027.

#upsc2027  #upscprelims2027  #upscpreparation  #upscpyq   #pyqanalysis  #upscstrategy  #levelupias
